LESSON: SELECTED HADITH • HADITH ON UNITY • HADITH ON AVOIDANCE OF ILL MOTIVES

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Hadith 2.1 Ulum al-Hadith • Books of Hadith • Classification of Hadith • Collect
Topic 2.2: Selected Hadith • Hadith on Unity • Hadith on Avoidance of ill motives
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Selected Hadith • Hadith on Unity • Hadith on Avoidance of ill motives, part of Hadith 2.1 Ulum al-Hadith • Books of Hadith • Classification of Hadith • Collect in Grade 9 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: Why is the unity of Muslims important? 2. Why should Muslims avoid ill motives?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. deduce lessons from the Hadith on unity and avoidance of ill motives among Muslims,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Selected Hadith • Hadith on Unity • Hadith on Avoidance of ill motives in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. explain the relevance of the Hadith on unity and avoidance of ill motives in the life of a Muslim,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Selected Hadith • Hadith on Unity • Hadith on Avoidance of ill motives in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. practise the teachings from the Hadith on unity and avoidance of ill motives in daily life,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Selected Hadith • Hadith on Unity • Hadith on Avoidance of ill motives in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. honour Hadith as the second source of law and spiritual guidance.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Selected Hadith • Hadith on Unity • Hadith on Avoidance of ill motives in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

• Learning to Learn: the skill of sharing learnt knowledge is enhanced as learners discuss the lessons derived from

the selected Hadith in groups.

• Creativity and Imagination: the skill of making connections is enhanced when learners explain the relevance of

the selected Hadith in the life of a Muslim and make notes.

• Communication and Collaboration: the skill of teamwork is enhanced as learners dramatise the effects of ill

motives.

Values:
● Unity is enhanced when learners discuss the lessons derived from the Hadith on unity in groups.

● Love is enhanced as learners discuss the lessons derived from the Hadith on unity in groups.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
● Social cohesion is enhanced as learners role-play the importance of unity in the community.

● Peace education is enhanced as learners role-play the importance of unity in the community.
